svg.title: Dynamic scene spike camera binary spike stream SCSR HR images and spike timing plots
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the full figure. Base frames: f01 top-left dynamic scene to HR images panel, f02 bottom-left pixel circuit panel, f03 legend panel, f04 right timing plots panel. Conduction inventories are described inside each grouped panel.

g.desc: Panel (a) inventory: label, Dynamic Scene car with motion lines, arrow to spike camera, spike camera on tripod, dashed orange optical guide to the pixel circuit below, perspective spike-camera array, red spike arrows, arrow to binary spike-stream cube with axes and orange dots, arrow to SCSR block, arrow to stacked grayscale HR images with car silhouette and rW/rH labels. Directional construction proceeds left to right from the dynamic scene origin; layout has horizontal left-to-right process symmetry.

Panel (b) inventory: orange label, photons from scene icon at left, dashed rays toward the one-pixel spike camera box, one-pixel dashed frame, receptor-integrator-comparator chain, reset loop from comparator to integrator, spike flag box, clock waveform and enable arrow, readout circuit and binary output. Construction proceeds from photons and sensor origin rightward through the circuit; the circuit follows a horizontal signal-flow basis.
Legend inventory: sample colored line and labels for Light Intensity, Threshold, Accumulation, Reset, Readout Time and Spike. Items are vertically equipartitioned in the compact green frame.

Panel (c) inventory: three stacked timing plots with axes. Top is light intensity I versus t with magenta smooth curve. Middle is accumulation A with dotted threshold, orange ramps, blue readout ticks, cyan reset lines and red spikes. Bottom is spike stream S with red spike impulses and binary digits. The plots are aligned vertically on common time direction; signal content is organized by a shared horizontal t-axis symmetry.
